fields.name: No answer
fields.default_next_action: Retry, then WhatsApp

fields.name: Busy or switched off
fields.default_next_action: Retry at a different time

fields.name: Customer asks to call later
fields.default_next_action: Call at the time customer gave

fields.name: Wrong or invalid number
fields.default_next_action: Check form or source for another number

fields.name: Not the decision maker
fields.default_next_action: Ask for decision maker's number or best time

fields.name: Interested, wants more information
fields.default_next_action: Send details, brochure or sample savings on WhatsApp

fields.name: Agrees, ready for site survey
fields.default_next_action: Book survey date and send confirmation

fields.name: Wants to discuss with family
fields.default_next_action: Offer a call with the family or a short presentation

fields.name: Price or budget concern
fields.default_next_action: Share financing, subsidy and payback details

fields.name: Not interested for now
fields.default_next_action: Ask when to contact again, record the reason

fields.name: Not interested at all
fields.default_next_action: Record the lost reason

fields.name: Already installed solar or booked with someone else
fields.default_next_action: Record reason, ask for a referral

fields.name: Not the owner, rented house or no suitable roof
fields.default_next_action: Ask whether the owner can be contacted

fields.name: Asked not to be called again
fields.default_next_action: Block calls and messages

fields.name: Duplicate enquiry
fields.default_next_action: Merge with the existing record

fields.name: Survey booked
fields.default_next_action: Send reminder the day before

fields.name: Customer asks to reschedule
fields.default_next_action: Book a new date, update reminder

fields.name: Customer not at site or not reachable on the day
fields.default_next_action: Call, rebook, note the missed visit

fields.name: Surveyor cancels or is delayed
fields.default_next_action: Inform the customer and rebook

fields.name: Survey done, site suitable
fields.default_next_action: Prepare the design and quotation

fields.name: Survey done, site not suitable (shade, weak roof, no space)
fields.default_next_action: Explain, offer a smaller system or another option, else record lost reason

fields.name: Customer changes mind before the survey
fields.default_next_action: Record the reason and next date

fields.name: Quote sent, no reply
fields.default_next_action: Follow up by call and WhatsApp on a set schedule

fields.name: Customer asks questions
fields.default_next_action: Answer and send missing details

fields.name: Customer asks for changes (size, brand, price)
fields.default_next_action: Send a revised quote and keep the old version

fields.name: Customer compares with another vendor
fields.default_next_action: Share differences in warranty, service and quality

fields.name: Customer wants to wait
fields.default_next_action: Record the reason and the date to call back

fields.name: Customer agrees
fields.default_next_action: Process ends here

fields.name: Customer rejects
fields.default_next_action: Record the reason (price, competitor, trust, timing, other)

fields.name: waiting for the owner or family
